note: The walker's sketchbook (docs/future/13 P2i I5; the sketchbook brief). With charcoal sticks in the pack and a creature, plant or find within reachM of you and under the middle of the view, Sketch joins the here-bar; the walker sits and draws for sketchS real seconds (going up or walking off stops it, and nothing is used). Stages (src/world/sketchbook/model.js): 1 the first sketch, 2 sketched on a later game day, 3 sketched during a moment (moments below), 4 in another season. Each stage shows its drawing from assets/sketches (art: a subject's file name where it differs from its journal id; tier 1 Rough, 2 Shading, 3 Detail), listed in assets/sketches/manifest.json by tools/assets/sketch-sheets.py ship. A stage with no drawing yet leaves its page blank paper. placeholderArt: the drawings in assets/sketches are Matt's placeholder sheets (October 25, 2026); the page wears a small Placeholder tag while true. Matt's real drawings drop in by file name. wearPer: sketches a handful of charcoal sticks lasts; loose: loose sheets kept a page; fullConfidence: sketches until the hand is sure (lines darker); ageDays: game days until the book's corners are as worn as they get. subjects: the pages, in the journal's order (creatures, plants, finds), by journal species id. moments: what counts as something happening for stage 3: rain or mist at least these, or the hour of the day inside dusk or dawn.

words.newPage: A new page in the sketchbook.
words.loose: Another sheet for the page. The hand is surer.
words.noSticks: The charcoal sticks are worn down to nothing.
words.empty: Nothing sketched yet. Charcoal sticks come from willow withies left in the fire overnight.
